title: Submodules of finite free modules over a PID have finite bases
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative principal ideal domain, meaning $1\ne0$, no zero divisors, and every ideal generated by one element. Let $M$ be an $A$-module with a basis $(e_j)_{j\in J}$ indexed by a finite set $J$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. For every $A$-submodule $S\subseteq M$, there are an integer $s\geq0$ and a basis $(b_i)_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(s)}$ of $S$: every element of $S$ is a unique sum $\sum_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(s)}a_i b_i$ with $a_i\in A$. The empty basis is allowed.
